parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token used to start the next query. Obtain this token from the response of the previous request.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:
- template: OOS template.
- execution: OOS task execution.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The label keys and values. You can specify 1 to 20 key-value pairs.
